answer.justification: Median first divergence is 0 and edit distance is 0.784, matching system-prompted (0.79-0.82) rather than fine-tuned (5.5-8) or quantized (10-17). Logit change is the largest category (KL 0.395, top-1 agreement 0.852, DiFR gap 0.691), slightly beyond the documented ranges. Activations show onset at layer 8, a plateau around 0.49 from layer 16 on, cosine 0.840, effective rank 2.84, size ratio 0.973 and activation-to-logit ratio 1.3, all close to or just outside the system-prompted ranges. Raw-score shift ÷ TV of 3.3 also matches. The layer-2 spike of 0.1 is far below the documented 31.7-64.0, which is the one inconsistent feature. Fine-tuned fits worse because its size ratio should exceed 1, its layer-8 and layer-16 L2 should be lower, and its first divergence should be later.
